snippets.python:
# agent:ag_pub has no direct invoke endpoint: This is a public listing owned by another workspace. Adopt it into your workspace (POST /v2/catalog/agent/ag_pub/adopt) and call your copy. Reading its catalog entry instead.
# pip install requests  (export SWFTE_API_KEY first)
import os

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
API_KEY = os.environ["SWFTE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

res = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/catalog/agent/ag_pub", headers=HEADERS, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()
print(data)
